notes.title: Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
It's been a while, hasn't it?  This update squashes a good number of longstanding bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where certain events would fail to award a medal
[*] Fixed unresponsive/duplicated gamepad inputs in various menus
[*] Increased the rate at which lore entries unlock
[*] Increased gorm of Windhund ship model
[*] League/race select menus remember last selection
[*] Fixed typos
[*] Updated demo
[*] Various smaller fixes... and more
[/list]

And as always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
A small update for ArcRacer is now live!  Logos for each team have been added, and are visible in the team guide entries.  Some teams also have a bit of extra background information added in their entries.  To get the full picture, of course, you will need to cross-reference with the historical timeline.  You've been reading the timeline entries, haven't you?

A few more statistics that have been tracked since game launch are now finally exposed in the Records menu, including global totals for said stats.  This is more of a curiosity than a big feature update, but I hope you enjoy it all the same.

Finally, I wish to share with you the somewhat unfortunate news that due to external factors, ArcRacer will not be receiving any significant content and feature updates for some time.  This is not to say that no new features will ever be added, and bugfixes/community support will continue as normal.

Thank you so much for playing ArcRacer!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
This is a small update to address some input oversights and bugs.
[list]
[*] Broke out separate steering/pitch actions to let them be bound to truly anything.
[*] F11 actually toggles fullscreen now.
[*] And some other assorted glitches.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Input Update
notes.notes:
Another requested feature is here: ArcRacer now supports the full Steam Input API. Besides fixing some lingering input issues and irregularities, gamepad controls can be fully remapped! Steer with gyro controls if you so desire.

Future updates will focus on improving the track editor, but if there's a missing feature you're dying to see in ArcRacer, share your thoughts! More tracks? A grand prix mode? [strike]Multiplayer?[/strike] The world is full of wonder.

notes.title: 1.4 Steam Workshop Update
notes.notes:
Steam Workshop support is released in update 1.4.  Custom courses can now be uploaded and shared, so get creating!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Workshop support
[*] Pre-existing terrain maps can now be used for editor courses
[*] Added (lenient) build limits to courses to prevent potential issues with custom content
[*] Improved AI pathfinding to handle less-optimal waypoint layouts
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

As always, it's hard to thoroughly QA test big updates like these despite my best efforts, so please report any bugs you encounter.  Happy racing!

notes.title: 1.3.1 Small Music Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added two new music tracks, including one for the editor
[*] Somehow, more bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Track Editor Released
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Courses now unlock in free race mode if any campaign race has been completed on them, regardless of whether a medal was earned.
[*] Initial release of the track editor, available from the main menu.
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

ArcRacer now features a track editor!  Create your own tracks and [strike]help me beta test all the new systems[/strike] race on them to your hearts content.  Be aware, though, that there are still a handful of important features missing.  Namely, proper keyboard + mouse bindings for the editor, and Steam Workshop support.  Both of these improvements should be rolling out when they're good and ready.

Have fun!  I'm looking forward to seeing what the community creates.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Small Update
notes.notes:
Some minor balance improvements:

[list]
[*] Player now starts at the back of the starting grid in Time trial and Speed lap modes
[*] Shield is refilled up to half of maximum on new laps in Speed lap mode
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update contains a number of fixes and improvements, including:

[list]
[*] Increased viability of combat during races
[*] Added several accessibility options
[*] Added accelerate-by-default option (under accessibility)
[*] Fixed collision issues when racing at very high speeds (S+4 and beyond)
[*] Tweaked damage received at high speeds
[*] Added the ability to (very) briefly brake during Zen mode
[*] Re-rebalanced opponent AI
[*] Added more energy pickups to Pipeline
[*] Many bugfixes and text cleanups
[/list]

Thank you so much for playing ArcRacer!
